description.value: Nesvog Meats & Sausage is a family-owned butcher, deli, and specialty grocer established in 2005 with Scandinavian roots, operating two Nanaimo locations. The Bowen Road shop carries store-made sausages, fresh and frozen meats, ready-to-eat deli items, baked goods, local produce from the Nesvog Family Farm, and a range of groceries. Voted #1 Best in the City for meat and deli, it offers a broad selection of gluten-free, dairy-free, and sugar-free options.
